Nanopb message definitions for Solana capture file metadata, accounts, rewards, and transactions.

# Purpose
This header file defines the nanopb message layout for the `solana_capture` data set and gives C structs for the records that are stored in or read from capture files. It describes file header metadata in `fd_solcap_FileMeta`, block and account state in `fd_solcap_BankPreimage`, `fd_solcap_AccountTableMeta`, and `fd_solcap_AccountMeta`, and reward and payout records in `fd_solcap_StakeRewardEpoch`, `fd_solcap_StakeRewardEvent`, `fd_solcap_VoteAccountPayout`, and `fd_solcap_StakeAccountPayout`. It also defines the `fd_solcap_Transaction` record for transaction status, error data, and instruction failure paths. The file includes field tags, default initializers, size limits, and message descriptors so code can encode and decode these records in a fixed binary format.
